draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.20, the 92nd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 8th of 29 at CB. He went 53rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (92nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3 passes defended in 2024, 21st of 29 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. 10 career games and 3 starts over 1 completed season, plus 3 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Weak spots: missed tackle rate 18.8% (6th percentile), passer rating allowed 112.2 (15th percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 cornerback who played: 34.4% season snap share against a median of 27.6%, above the norm.
